about: Real replies (live DB, 2026-10-17/18) where Haggle claimed a requirement wasn't stated although it was, or asked a business to restate a fact of the request. Each case pairs the business's words with what Claude returns under the per-requirement schema (requirement_checks), plus the real Claude output that triggered the miss where it matters. Phone numbers removed. Tests: packages/engine/tests/requirementChecks.test.ts.

cases.name: harbor-table-date-in-prose
cases.live_miss: Haggle emailed 'Could you also tell us: - Saturday, October 24, 2026' although the reply opened with 'on Saturday October 24' (date requirement was always 'needs review').
cases.body:
Hello there,

What a lovely evening to be part of! We'd be delighted to cater your client's dinner at Y Combinator HQ on Saturday October 24, and we can meet every requirement on your list.

For 100 guests, we're proposing our lemon-herb chicken with roasted fingerling potatoes, and 20 of those meals will be our eggplant parmesan, fully vegetarian and just as hearty. That matches the 20 vegetarian meals your client requested, all within the 100 total.

The total comes to $3,200, which works out to $32 per person, and delivery to Y Combinator HQ is included.

Warmly,
Elena
Harbor Table Catering

menu_items: lemon-herb chicken with roasted fingerling potatoes

requirement_checks.evidence: 20 of those meals will be our eggplant parmesan, fully vegetarian
delivery to Y Combinator HQ is included
cater your client's dinner at Y Combinator HQ on Saturday October 24

cases.name: sunset-kitchen-date-not-repeated
cases.live_miss: Quote for the request without restating the date: Haggle followed up asking for 'Saturday, October 24, 2026'. A fact of the request is accepted when the business quotes for it without contradicting it.
cases.body:
Hi there,

Here's your full quote for 100 people:

- Chicken piccata and lemon bars for 100
- 20 roasted vegetable lasagnas, so 20 vegetarian meals, just like you asked
- Plates, cutlery and napkins for everyone
- Delivery is included

Total comes to $3,025, which works out to $30.25 a head. We'd need a $302.50 deposit to hold the date.

Cheers,
Maya @ Sunset Kitchen

requirement_checks.evidence: 20 roasted vegetable lasagnas, so 20 vegetarian meals

requirement_checks.note: date not mentioned in the reply

cases.name: golden-grill-20-veg-or-more-text
cases.live_miss: Claude keyed the need as '20 vegetarian' (the prompt said 'Dietary needs: 20 vegetarian'), the lookup by 'vegetarian' failed, and Haggle asked 'At least 20 vegetarian meals (included in the 100), Saturday, October 24, 2026' although the text said '20 veg meals or more'.
cases.body: can do $13/prseon + $50 delivery fee + 8% tax. i can do 20 veg meals or more if u want

requirement_checks.evidence: i can do 20 veg meals or more

later.body:
[Haggle's last text to the business, for context only; these are not the business's words]: Hi Golden Grill, Haggle (AI assistant) again about dinner catering for 100 meals. Could you text back your exact all-in total, incl. delivery and tax, and the deposit? HG-ZQ9R
[The business's reply]: 1454
later.live_miss: The short reply '1454' came back with dietary 'vegetarian' covered:false (not mentioned), which turned the requirement into 'business said it can't cover it'.

cases.name: mission-eats-call-all-veg-then-confirms-date
cases.live_miss: 'we will obviously do all the vegetarian meals that you need' had no count, so the requirement stayed unknown; the follow-up call's transcript ('Could you confirm lunch delivery on that date?' / 'Yeah, yeah') then set vegetarian covered:false and the quote was marked 'business said it can't cover it'.
cases.body:
local: Great, the customer is looking for lunch catering for forty people on Friday, October 30th, delivered to the Y Combinator office in San Francisco, with at least 12 of those meals being vegetarian.
remote: Um, yeah, so, so, to answer your question, it'll be seventeen dollars per meal. Plus a hundred dollars for delivery and then 10% tax. And then we will obviously do all the vegetarian meals that you need. And that includes setup, delivery, etc. Yeah
local: Got it. Is there a deposit required?
remote: Um, yeah, two fifty bucks

requirement_checks.evidence: we will obviously do all the vegetarian meals that you need
requirement_checks.note: will cover all vegetarian meals asked for (12)

requirement_checks.evidence: to answer your question, it'll be seventeen dollars per meal
requirement_checks.note: quoted for the request as sent, not contradicted

later.body:
local: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of a customer, checking on lunch delivery for October 30th, 2026.
remote: Okay, what's up
local: Mission Eats already quoted for lunch catering, 40 meals delivered to Y Combinator's office in San Francisco on October 30th, 2026. Could you confirm lunch delivery on that date?
remote: Yeah, yeah
local: Great, thanks for confirming that.
remote: Okay
later.live_miss: Real Claude output for this transcript: dietary vegetarian covered:false, every money field missing.

requirement_checks.note: confirmed lunch delivery on October 30 when the assistant read it back

cases.name: delivery-stated-only-in-prose
cases.live_miss: Paraphrase of live replies that state delivery only in a sentence ('lunch will arrive on the day', 'we bring it to you'): the keyword rules need delivery_included or a fee, so a reader that left both null produced 'delivery not stated'.
cases.body:
Hello,

The menu is lemon-herb chicken and seasonal greens for 40, plus 12 mushroom risotto meals for your vegetarian guests. We'll bring everything to the Y Combinator office ourselves and lunch will arrive on the day.

Warmly,

cases.name: numbers-and-contradictions-still-count
cases.live_miss: Guard case (not a miss): a stated count below the minimum is a no even if a reader says yes, and a different date is a no.
cases.body: We could do this on Sunday the 25th instead (Saturday is booked): $2,900 total, delivered, with 10 vegetarian plates.

cases.name: genuinely-unaddressed-is-still-asked
cases.live_miss: Guard case: a requirement the business never addressed and that isn't a fact of the request (delivery) still gets one follow-up.
